prompt: Research the current official API prices (per million input and output tokens) of OpenAI's current GPT models. Cite OpenAI's own pricing page and quote the prices.
Research the current official API prices (per million input and output tokens) of Anthropic's current Claude models. Cite Anthropic's own pricing page and quote the prices.
Research the officially documented free-tier rate limits of the Google Gemini API (requests per minute and per day) for its current models. Cite Google's documentation and quote the limits.
Research the officially documented limits of AWS Lambda: maximum timeout, maximum memory, and the monthly free tier. Cite AWS's own documentation and quote the limits.
Research the officially documented limits of Vercel's free Hobby plan (bandwidth, function invocations or duration, build minutes). Cite Vercel's documentation and quote the limits.
Research the officially documented limits of Supabase's free plan (database size, monthly active users, file storage, project pausing). Cite Supabase's own page and quote the limits.
Research Docker Hub's officially documented pull rate limits for unauthenticated and authenticated free users. Cite Docker's documentation and quote the limits.
Research Stripe's officially published standard card processing fees for the United States and for European cards. Cite Stripe's own pricing page and quote the fees.
Research the officially documented limits of the Telegram Bot API: messages per second, file upload and download size. Cite Telegram's own documentation or FAQ and quote the limits.
Research the officially documented limits for Discord users: message length and file upload size, for free users and Nitro subscribers. Cite Discord's own support pages and quote the limits.

Research which Python versions the CPython developers currently list as in bugfix, security-only, or end-of-life status, and the end-of-life dates. Cite the Python developer guide or python.org page and quote it.
Research the Kubernetes project's official policy on how many minor versions are supported at once and for how long each receives patches. Cite the Kubernetes documentation and quote it.
Research Canonical's official statement on how long an Ubuntu LTS release receives standard support, and how long with Ubuntu Pro / ESM. Cite Canonical's own page and quote the periods.
Research the officially documented limits of Tailscale's free Personal plan (users, devices, other limits). Cite Tailscale's own pricing or documentation page and quote the limits.
Research the officially documented free tier of Cloudflare R2 (storage, Class A and Class B operations, egress). Cite Cloudflare's documentation and quote the numbers.
Research Polymarket's officially documented trading fees (maker and taker fees, any market-specific fees). Cite Polymarket's own documentation and quote what it says.
Research YouTube's officially documented upload limits: maximum file size and maximum video length, and how to upload longer videos. Cite YouTube's own help page and quote the limits.
Research the current official API prices of DeepSeek's models (per million input and output tokens, including cache-hit pricing). Cite DeepSeek's own pricing page and quote the prices.
Research the current official GitHub Copilot plans: monthly price and the number of premium requests included in each plan. Cite GitHub's own page or documentation and quote the numbers.
Research the fee OpenRouter charges when buying credits (card and crypto), and any fee on bring-your-own-key usage. Cite OpenRouter's own documentation or FAQ and quote it.
Research the Chrome browser's officially documented release cycle (how many weeks between major stable releases, and the Extended Stable option). Cite the Chromium or Google page and quote it.
Research the officially documented limits of GitHub Pages (published site size, monthly bandwidth, builds per hour). Cite GitHub's documentation page and quote the limits.

Research the officially documented limits of a free Gmail / Google account: total storage, attachment size for sending and receiving, recipients per day. Cite Google's own help pages and quote the limits.
Research the officially documented limits of the Home Assistant Cloud (Nabu Casa) subscription: price per month and what is included. Cite the Nabu Casa page and quote it.
